basic_profile.bio: I'm a gaming enthusiast based in a small town in Ohio. I've recently fallen in love with online multiplayer games like Fallout 76 and The Infected. My interests also extend to Japanese women's wrestling (joshi) and anime, particularly DanMachi. Outside gaming, I'm a part-time retail worker and a full-time student pursuing a degree in Business Administration. I'm usually online in the evenings and late-night hours since I juggle between work and classes during the day. I enjoy discussing game strategies and sharing my in-game experiences with others. Currently single, enjoying the freedom to game whenever I want!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been gaming since my early teens, picking up tips and tricks from online forums and YouTube channels. My knowledge of joshi wrestling comes from watching countless matches and following the community on Reddit. My anime insights are mostly self-taught, binge-watching series and engaging in discussions on related subreddits.
